Heat wave peaks: 106 in Beverly Hills, 109 in Woodland Hills

LABD weather team Sep 10, 2026
Facebook · X · LinkedIn · WhatsApp · Email

Southern California's September heat wave hit its peak on Thursday, with temperatures reaching 106 degrees in Beverly Hills and 109 in Woodland Hills. An excessive heat warning remains in effect through Saturday, Sept 12.

Cooling centers are open across the county. Utilities asked customers to conserve power between 4 and 9 p.m.

Rodeo Drive was noticeably quiet at midday. Some stores reported tourists ducking in for the air conditioning rather than to shop.
